answer: Coordinated escrow cliff: each agent's escrow account holds an opal-tier reserve that unlocks only after its declared peers complete matching escrow. Enforcement: an identity's spendable balance stays locked behind a ledge of unconsummated peer escrows, so a clone cluster must fund every member's escrow from separate capital. Attacker cost: N distinct reserves plus idle capital in each vault, paid per identity regardless of shared control.
